findings.mechanism: Per-session setInterval timer holds a closure over the session
findings.cause: Candidate: timer never cleared after disconnect
findings.evidence: Session.close() calls clearInterval(this.heartbeat) (src/session.js:306) on every close path (socket, bye, idle, protocol). Ran 5 waves x 20000 connections on one Gateway with heartbeatMs=50: heapUsed after gc flat at ~4.1MB, active handles 0.
findings.discriminator: After each wave gateway.size==0 and process._getActiveHandles().length==0; heap flat after forced GC, so no timer/session survives.

findings.mechanism: Router.topics Map of topic -> Set of sessions
findings.cause: Candidate: sessions retained by topic membership
findings.evidence: close() unsubscribes every topic, and unsubscribe deletes empty topic entries. After waves topics.size==0.
findings.discriminator: router.topics.size is 0 and sessions.size is 0 after every wave.

findings.evidence: remember() caps at RECENT_LIMIT=64 with shift(); buffer is owned by the session, which is dropped from Gateway.sessions on release.
findings.discriminator: Bounded at 64 entries and freed with the session.

findings.mechanism: Metrics counters Map and latency array
findings.evidence: Keys are a fixed set (accepted, released, frames_*, events_out, closed_<4 reasons>, unknown_type, protocol_errors); latency array is fixed-size.
findings.discriminator: Key set is bounded by code, not by client input or session count.

findings.mechanism: Decoder.pending holds a subarray of the received chunk Buffer
findings.cause: Candidate: Buffer slices pin whole chunk
findings.evidence: Per-session and dropped with the session; max one frame (64KB cap) is retained. RSS rose from ~77MB to ~120MB on first large run, then flat (118.1/120.8/120.7/120.5 over 4 waves of 100000) while heapUsed stayed ~3.3MB.
findings.discriminator: RSS plateaus after first wave rather than growing per wave: allocator/Buffer pool high-water mark, not retention.

findings.cause: Test-harness only; real net sockets do not keep written data
findings.evidence: Held only by the socket, which is unreachable once the session is released.
findings.discriminator: Not used by the production gateway; freed with the socket.

summary: No leak found in this checkout: under repeated connect/exchange/disconnect waves, heap after GC, session count, topic count and active handles all stay flat. The only RSS rise is a first-wave plateau.
